headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 1,484 points as broad-based sell-off hit Dalal Street; market closed today for holiday

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Thursday, 26 November.

why: Indian stock markets are closed today, 24 November, on account of Guru Nanak Jayanti.
In the previous session, benchmark indices faced severe selling pressure led by metal and banking stocks.
Investors lost over ₹6 lakh crore in wealth during Monday's sharp market crash.
Global and domestic concerns triggered a broad-based plunge, taking Nifty below the 25,400 mark.
whatHappening: Indian share markets are shut today for an NSE trading holiday and will reopen on Thursday, 26 November.
On the last trading day (23 Nov), Sensex slipped 1,484 points while Nifty shed 451 points.
Ionic Wealth raised ₹177 crore in funding from Angel One, Anil Kapoor, and others.
India AI funding nearly doubled to $1.6 billion in the first nine months of 2026, according to a Tracxn report.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today, 24 November, due to a scheduled trading holiday for Guru Nanak Jayanti.
In the last trading session on Monday, benchmark indices suffered a massive sell-off as Sensex plunged 1,484 points and Nifty dropped below 25,400.
Metal and banking stocks led the decline wiping out ₹6 lakh crore of investor wealth, while IT stocks managed to show relative resilience.
